sap.app.title: Semantic Page - Master Detail
sap.app.description: Full master-detail layout using sap.m.semantic.MasterPage and DetailPage inside a SplitContainer. Demonstrates semantic action slots (addAction, positiveAction, negativeAction, forwardAction, flagAction, favoriteAction, and more), a PagingButton, PageAccessibleLandmarkInfo, and MessagePopover/MessageToast feedback when actions are pressed.
